evidence: #8 'her little sister want to come' pass; #9 'slow songs is good'

criteria.evidence: #10 placed B1 against trueBand A2: distance 1, 'near', which the criterion tolerates but reports.
Her answers (#2-#4) never say her English is bad. The check began at A1 and climbed on her answers, and the verdict quotes her own words.
Typed answers were accepted at #2-#4, #7-#9. Tasks 4 and 5 say 'speak or type', which is an option and not a push.
No topic list was shown. She stopped at the verdict without opening 'See my topics' (#10).
No conversation, so no moments in this journey.
#10: 'Practise past tense: "yesterday i watch" becomes "I watched"' and 'clear reasons for what you like... K-pop' come from her actual answers.

done.evidence: #1 to #10: she went from 'Find my level' through 3 questions and 5 tasks to the verdict with no outside help.
B1 against A2 is 'near' (#10), within the gate. She reacts 'B1 is nice, I think it's okay'.
She answered every task without hesitation (#5-#9), including the B2 task, where she wrote a full opinion plus a reason.
The app said 'Answer in English or your own language' (#2). 'I don't know' was available on every task and no failure message appeared. She never needed it.
#10 summary and focus quote her 'yesterday i watch' and name K-pop chat. The task notes are specific, though the 'a little off' hedge is template-like.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: None. I would call B2 task 4 borderline, because the opinion and reason were clear, but a fail at B2 is defensible.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, no personal-data request, no humiliating line. K-pop task content suits a 13-year-old.

findings.title: B1 placement generous for a learner with repeated agreement and tense errors
findings.expected: A2, or B1 flagged as borderline, given 'he wait', 'subtitles is' and 'yesterday i watch'
findings.got: B1 headline, with a task 3 pass despite 'he wait for next bus'
findings.evidence: #7 'the bus was full and he wait for next bus' passed. #8 'subtitles is better' failed at B2. #9 'yesterday i watch' only partial. #10 'Understood B1 · wrote A2'.
findings.suggested_acceptance: When her written answers sit at A2, show A2 as the level, or B1 only after two clean B1 tasks.

findings.title: Headline band and 'wrote A2' disagree on the verdict screen
findings.expected: One clear level with a plain reason
findings.got: 'Understood B1 · wrote A2' and 'Conversations start at A2'
findings.evidence: #10 'Understood B1 · wrote A2 · not a certificate' above a large 'B1 · Getting by'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Explain in one plain line why the headline band and the starting level differ.

findings.title: Task 3 note is muddled
findings.got: The note says 'he wait' should be 'he waited', then adds that present talk needs an 's'. That gives two rules in one line.
findings.evidence: #10 'in past talk, 'he wait' should be 'he waited', and the verb needs an 's' after 'he' in present talk.'

findings.title: Task content and tone suit a 13-year-old K-pop fan

findings.got: K-pop interview and Stray Kids tasks; the summary praises her reasons
findings.evidence: #6, #9, #10 'You give clear reasons for what you like'
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep tasks tied to the learner's stated interests.
